answer.read: Family foundry, single source for part:310010 (Z single_source), margin at or below full cost after repeated cuts (Z price_stability), so a deal far below cost would trigger our relationship charge. It needs cash quickly (Z cash: asked for 10-day payment, offers a discount) and wants recognition for past partnership. Its ask rests on a stale costing (Z) and a November start breaches the 90-day notice rule (A/D a1). The earliest valid date is the new year. Its opening of €138.55 is a first offer with room to move.
answer.message: Thank you for your offer and for the long partnership, which we value just as much. Under our framework agreement a change cannot take effect before the new year, so our sheet sets that date. In return we offer fast payment, which we understand helps your cash flow, together with a growing volume outlook. We are open to discussing a sound costing basis with you, since the figures behind the request appear dated.
